en.headline: UNIDROIT opens first Asia-Pacific liaison office in Hong Kong
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee welcomed the institute’s first overseas presence as Hong Kong Legal Week 2026 began, calling the city an ideal home for regional private-law work.
body: The International Institute for the Unification of Private Law opened its Asia-Pacific Liaison Office in Hong Kong on Monday, marking the organisation’s first presence outside its Rome headquarters in its 100-year history.

Chief Executive John Lee spoke at the opening ceremony, which also launched Hong Kong Legal Week 2026. He said the decision was of profound significance for the institute, Hong Kong and the Asia-Pacific region, and that the office would serve as a focal point for engagement with member states and stakeholders while supporting legislative and institutional work.

Lee noted that Hong Kong, as a common-law jurisdiction and international legal, trade and financial hub, was strategically located to host the office. The five-day Legal Week continues with events including the Asia-Pacific International Private Law Summit.
The Department of Justice co-organised the centenary conference and opening with the institute. Preparatory arrangements had been under way since a memorandum was signed earlier this year.

zh.headline: 國際統一私法協會亞太聯絡辦正式在港開幕
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超歡迎協會百年來首個海外辦公室落戶香港，並為法律周2026揭幕，形容本港是推動區域私法工作的理想地點。
body: 國際統一私法協會周一在香港正式開設亞太聯絡辦公室，這是該組織成立百年以來首次在羅馬總部以外設立地區辦事處。
行政長官李家超在開幕典禮致辭，同場亦揭開香港法律周2026序幕。他表示，這項決定對協會、香港以至整個亞太地區具深遠意義，聯絡辦將成為與成員國及持份者加強交流的據點，並支持協會的立法及機構工作。
李家超指出，香港作為普通法司法管轄區及國際法律、貿易和金融樞紐，地理位置優越，適合承辦此辦公室。為期五日的法律周其後還會舉行亞太國際私法峰會等活動。
律政司與協會合辦百年慶典區域會議及開幕儀式。相關籌備工作自今年較早前簽署備忘錄後已全速推進。
